name: DEFAULT_MAX_TASK_ARCHIVE_BYTES

name: MAX_PARENTS

name: HEALTH_INTERVAL_S

name: DEFAULT_STEPS

name: MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
desc: Largest inference request body; weight uploads stream and are not bound by it.

name: MAX_TASK_FILES

name: WAIT_SECONDS
desc: The bound of one wait, for a host that runs many tests at once. No test waits a fixed time.

name: NATIVE_PATTERN_MAX_LENGTH
desc: Admission bounds pattern length; the interpreter separately bounds search text and execution time.
